subject: Argentum: Decision criteria & next steps (latency, deployment, procurement)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@argentum.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Argentum: Decision criteria & next steps (latency, deployment, procurement)

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great discussion. Quick recap + asks to keep momentum:

1) Decision criteria we heard in the call
   - Latency: target mentioned around 200-250ms (need confirmation of p95 vs p99)
   - Cost: target runway constraints - would like to validate cost per 1k tokens for both hosted and dedicated modes
   - Deployment mode: you indicated a preference for private/VPC for production due to data controls; hosted ok for pilot
   - SLA: expected uptime/latency SLOs and incident response expectations to be included in procurement docs

2) Stakeholder map (as we understood it) - can you confirm/correct?
   - Economic buyer: Priya Mehta (Procurement)
   - Technical buyer / Exec sponsor: Alex Turner (CTO)
   - Security / Legal: Sam Patel (Security) + internal legal
   - Procurement POC: Priya Mehta (procurement@argentum.com)

3) Next steps / asks from Redwood
   - Alex / Sam: please confirm latency target (200ms or 250ms) and whether you measure p95 or p99.
   - Priya: procurement timeline and any mandatory PO/contract requirements (DocuSign, vendor onboarding forms, PO lead time).
   - Rishi / Priyom (cc'd): we'll prepare a short tech note on deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with expected latency profiles and estimated cost for a baseline workload.

Attachments: demo recording and SLA matrix attached for reference.

Proposed timeline:
 - By EOD tomorrow: confirm latency SLO target and procurement owner
 - Within 3 business days: Redwood to send deployment/cost note + answers to security questionnaire

Thanks - happy to hop back on a short call if that helps to align quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (video stub), redwood-sla-matrix.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@argentum.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@argentum.com>, Priya Mehta <procurement@argentum.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Argentum: Decision criteria & next steps (latency, deployment, procurement)

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: we do want 200ms p95 in production for the core customer-facing flows. For less critical batch workflows, higher latency is acceptable.
- Deployment: we will require a VPC/private deployment for production (data residency + network controls). Hosted API is fine for a 6-8 week pilot if you can guarantee isolation and logging.
- Security / compliance: Sam will send the security questionnaire (attached). We also need vendor SOC2 evidence and an engineering security call next week.
- Procurement: Priya is the procurement lead - our timeline is fairly aggressive (2 weeks) to complete vendor vetting and PO issuance if everything lines up.

Stakeholders:
 - Alex Turner - CTO (alex.turner@argentum.com)
 - Sam Patel - Head of Security (sam.patel@argentum.com)
 - Priya Mehta - Sr. Procurement Manager (procurement@argentum.com)

I've attached the initial security questionnaire. Priya, looped - can you confirm procurement requirements and PO cadence?

Thanks,
Alex
CTO | Argentum Financial

Attachments: security-questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@argentum.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@argentum.com>, Priya Mehta <procurement@argentum.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Argentum: Decision criteria & next steps (latency, deployment, procurement)

Alex - perfect, thanks for the confirmation. A couple of quick follow-ups so we prepare the right materials:

1) Latency detail: confirmed 200ms p95 for core flows - can you confirm whether you also track p99 for SLO punching (we typically provide both) and whether there are separate targets for the three flow types (auth, query, long-form generation).
2) Pilot profile: can you share expected QPS / RPS for pilot and typical payload sizes (avg tokens in / tokens out)? This will help us size a dedicated capacity estimate vs hosted cost.
3) Security call: Rishi (solutions) is available next Wed/Thu; Sam, what times work for you?

Proposed immediate deliverables from Redwood (timeline in parentheses):
 - Deployment options note (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + expected latency p95/p99 profiles (1 business day)
 - Ballpark cost for pilot (hosted) and 90-day dedicated reserve (2 business days)
 - SOC2 evidence + answers to the questionnaire (Rishi to start today; delivery 3 business days)

If that works I'll assemble the materials and send as a single package.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@argentum.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@argentum.com>, Priya Mehta <procurement@argentum.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Argentum: internal - ask list for latency/cost/SOC2 followup

Rishi / Priyom - quick internal ask to prepare our package for Argentum: 

1) Latency profiles: provide expected p95 and p99 numbers for the following deployment modes for the core query flow (assume 2-4 token outputs on avg):
   - Hosted (shared, standard plan)
   - Dedicated reserved pool (single-tenant GPU pool)
   - Private / VPC (customer-managed network)

2) Cost estimate: ballpark monthly cost for a 90-day reserved capacity to support 50 RPS baseline with bursts to 150 RPS; include Monthly $ and $/1k tokens estimate for hosted pilot.

3) SOC2 + security questionnaire: start filling Argentum's attached spreadsheet. Note any gaps and provide timelines to remediate.

Deliverable timeline: 24-48 hours. Let me know if you need a call.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@argentum.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@argentum.com>, Priya Mehta <procurement@argentum.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Feb 2028 18:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Argentum: Decision criteria & next steps (latency, deployment, procurement)

Marissa - thanks, this looks good. A few final notes:

- Confirmed: 200ms p95 for production core flows (we will track p99 internally, but p95 is our procurement SLO).
- Pilot: we can start with hosted for 6 weeks; production will require VPC/private.
- Procurement: Priya confirms a 2-week vendor vetting + PO issuance cadence assuming security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence are satisfactory.

Priya: I'll review and aim to turn the procurement docs within the next 10 business days. If we encounter any legal contract redlines I'll surface them early.

Alex
CTO | Argentum Financial

Attachments: argentum-security-answers.xlsx, DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abcdef123456
